dataset.label: Synthetic, repository-authored diagnostic evaluation; not an external benchmark or held-out research test

protocol.aggregation: macro mean over answerable queries; unsupported queries excluded from ranking metrics
protocol.cold_scope: one fresh evaluator process; import and index construction separated; OS/filesystem caches not cleared; first method calls share one index
protocol.latency_scope: local retrieval calls only; excludes HTTP, network, generation, rate limiting and model downloads
protocol.limitations: Small authored diagnostic set derived from two educational documents; not held out, external, traffic weighted, production telemetry or an answer-generation benchmark. No retrieval tuning performed.
protocol.relevance: binary; unlisted chunks treated as non-relevant

unsupported_cases.interpretation: Diagnostic rankings only. No retrieval abstention threshold or answer/refusal accuracy is measured.
